mapper.sql: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs vp WHERE vp.facility_id = f.facility_id AND vp.apply_method IS NOT NULL AND vp.apply_method <> '') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs vp WHERE vp.facility_id = f.facility_id AND vp.apply_method REGEXP '인터넷|온라인|홈페이지'))
mapper.select: SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.lat, f.lng, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.capacity, f.rental_url, fs.reserve_url, AS visit_only, ds.site_url AS district_url, ds.rental_url AS district_rental_url, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(f.lng, f.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM facilities f JOIN facility_sports fs ON fs.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fs.sport_id = #{sportId} LEFT JOIN district_sites ds ON ds.gu_name = f.gu_name WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND f.is_active = 1

SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.lat, f.lng, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.capacity, f.rental_url,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = f.facility_id AND p.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND p.program_type = 'COURSE') AS course_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = f.facility_id AND p.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND p.program_type = 'COURSE'
AND ( #{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR p.target IS NULL OR p.target REGEXP '누구나|전체|제한없|일반' OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'ADULT' AND p.target REGEXP '성인') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TEEN' AND p.target REGEXP '청소년|중등|고등|초중고') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'CHILD' AND p.target REGEXP '어린이|유아|초등') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'SENIOR' AND p.target REGEXP '노인|어르신|경로|성인') ) ) AS my_course_count, -- 예약 링크는 시설이 아니라 '시설 x 종목' 단위. -- 같은 복합시설이라도 테니스장만 예약 대상인 경우가 있음. fs.reserve_url, AS visit_only, -- 시설 주소가 없을 때 쓸 자치구 창구. 강습과 대관을 따로 둔다 ds.site_url AS district_url, ds.rental_url AS district_rental_url, -- 두 좌표 사이 실제 거리를 미터로 주는 내장 함수. 1000 으로 나눠 km 로 쓴다. -- POINT 는 (경도, 위도) 순서다. ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(f.lng, f.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM facility_sports fs JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id LEFT JOIN district_sites ds ON ds.gu_name = f.gu_name WHERE fs.sport_id = #{sportId} AND f.is_active = 1
AND ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(f.lng, f.lat)) <= 5000 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs pp WHERE pp.facility_id = fs.facility_id AND pp.sport_id = fs.sport_id) OR (f.homepage_url IS NOT NULL AND f.homepage_url <> '') OR (f.rental_url IS NOT NULL AND f.rental_url <> '') OR (fs.reserve_url IS NOT NULL AND fs.reserve_url <> '') )
AND NOT ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs cp WHERE cp.facility_id = fs.facility_id AND cp.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND cp.program_type = 'COURSE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs cp WHERE cp.facility_id = fs.facility_id AND cp.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND cp.program_type = 'COURSE' AND ( #{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL
OR ( cp.target IS NULL AND NOT ( f.name REGEXP '청소년|어린이|유아' AND #{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ('ADULT','SENIOR') ) ) OR cp.target REGEXP '누구나|전체|제한없|일반' OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'ADULT' AND cp.target REGEXP '성인') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'TEEN' AND cp.target REGEXP '청소년|중등|고등|초중고') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'CHILD' AND cp.target REGEXP '어린이|유아|초등') OR (#{ageBand,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'SENIOR' AND cp.target REGEXP '노인|어르신|경로|성인') )) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs cp WHERE cp.facility_id = fs.facility_id AND cp.sport_id = fs.sport_id AND cp.program_type <> 'COURSE') ) ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MIN(p.program_id) AS program_id, p.facility_id, p.sport_id, p.name, p.target, MIN(p.reservation_url) AS reservation_url, p.program_type,
COUNT(*) AS class_count FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND p.sport_id = #{sportId} AND ( p.target IS NULL OR p.target REGEXP '누구나|전체|제한없|일반' OR (#{ageBand} = 'ADULT' AND p.target REGEXP '성인') OR (#{ageBand} = 'TEEN' AND p.target REGEXP '청소년|중등|고등|초중고') OR (#{ageBand} = 'CHILD' AND p.target REGEXP '어린이|유아|초등') -- 어르신도 성인 대상 강좌를 신청할 수 있어 함께 남긴다 OR (#{ageBand} = 'SENIOR' AND p.target REGEXP '노인|어르신|경로|성인') ) GROUP BY p.facility_id, p.sport_id, p.name, p.target, p.program_type
ORDER BY p.program_type = 'COURSE' DESC, class_count DESC, p.name
mapper.sql: r.svc_url LIKE 'http%' AND r.lat IS NOT NULL AND r.lng IS NOT NULL -- 원본이 '2026-08-19 23:59:00.0' 처럼 끝에 .0 이 붙어 오므로 앞 19자만 쓴다 AND STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(r.rcpt_end, 19), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT r.place_name, r.min_class, r.pay_yn, r.svc_url, r.lat, r.lng, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(r.lng, r.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM reservation_raw r JOIN (SELECT place_name, MIN(rcpt_end) AS first_end FROM reservation_raw r WHERE GROUP BY place_name) pick ON pick.place_name = r.place_name AND pick.first_end = r.rcpt_end WHERE
AND r.min_class = CASE #{sportId} WHEN 4 THEN '배드민턴장' WHEN 5 THEN '탁구장' WHEN 6 THEN '테니스장' WHEN 7 THEN '농구장' END GROUP BY r.place_name ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.place_name, r.min_class, r.pay_yn, r.svc_url, r.lat, r.lng, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), POINT(r.lng, r.lat)) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM reservation_raw r JOIN (SELECT place_name, MIN(rcpt_end) AS first_end FROM reservation_raw r WHERE GROUP BY place_name) pick ON pick.place_name = r.place_name AND pick.first_end = r.rcpt_end WHERE AND r.min_class IN ('풋살장', '축구장') GROUP BY r.place_name ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT #{limit}
